import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
    
    smallestError = 1e10
    bestA = 0
    bestB = 0
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        val = x * i / y
        tx = int(val + 0.5 - 1e-7)
        
        error = abs(x / y - tx / i)
        
        if error < smallestError:
            smallestError = error
            bestA = tx
            bestB = i
    
    print(f"{bestA}/{bestB}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
